<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>Prime Bank × Aarong – 25% Exclusive Offer</title>
  <style>
    * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
    body { background: #f4f4f4; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; padding: 20px; }
    .wrapper { max-width: 600px; margin: 0 auto; background: #fff; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #e0e0e0; overflow: hidden; }

    .header { background: #fff; padding: 20px 32px; border-bottom: 2px solid #f0f0f0; }
    .header-inner { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; }
    .header-inner img.prime { height: 44px; width: auto; }
    .header-inner .sep { font-size: 20px; color: #ccc; font-weight: 300; }
    .header-inner img.aarong { height: 56px; width: auto; }

    .hero { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fff8f0, #fff3e6); padding: 40px 32px; text-align: center; border-bottom: 1px solid #f0e0d0; }
    .tag { display: inline-block; background: #ff6b00; color: #fff; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 5px 16px; border-radius: 20px; margin-bottom: 20px; }
    .big-discount { font-size: 96px; font-weight: 900; color: #d4890a; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -4px; }
    .big-discount sup { font-size: 46px; vertical-align: super; }
    .discount-word { font-size: 34px; font-weight: 900; color: #222; letter-spacing: 4px; text-transform: uppercase; margin-top: 4px; }
    .at-aarong { font-size: 20px; color: #555; margin-top: 8px; }
    .at-aarong span { color: #ff6b00; font-weight: 700; }

    .card-section { padding: 32px; text-align: center; background: #fff; border-bottom: 1px solid #f0f0f0; }
    .card-section p { font-size: 15px; color: #444; line-height: 1.7; margin: 0; }
    .card-section p strong { color: #1a5fa8; }

    .benefits { background: #fafafa; border-top: 1px solid #eee; border-bottom: 1px solid #eee; padding: 28px 32px; }
    .benefits table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; }
    .benefits td { width: 33.33%; text-align: center; padding: 12px 8px; vertical-align: top; border-right: 1px solid #e8e8e8; }
    .benefits td:last-child { border-right: none; }
    .ben-icon { font-size: 26px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
    .ben-val { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 800; color: #d4890a; }
    .ben-desc { font-size: 12px; color: #666; line-height: 1.5; margin-top: 4px; }
    .ben-desc strong { color: #ff6b00; }

    .cta { padding: 36px 32px; text-align: center; background: #fff; }
    .cta p { font-size: 13px; color: #888; margin-bottom: 20px; }
    .cta-btn { display: inline-block; background: #d4890a; color: #fff; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; padding: 16px 44px; border-radius: 50px; }
    .terms { font-size: 11px; color: #aaa; margin-top: 16px; line-height: 1.6; }

    .footer { background: #f8f8f8; border-top: 1px solid #e8e8e8; padding: 18px 32px; text-align: center; }
    .footer p { font-size: 11px; color: #aaa; margin: 3px 0; line-height: 1.7; }
    .footer a { color: #d4890a; text-decoration: none; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="wrapper">

  <div class="header">
    <div class="header-inner">
      <img class="prime" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Prime Bank" />
      <span class="sep">×</span>
      <img class="aarong" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Aarong" />
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="hero">
    <div class="tag">Exclusive Employee Benefit</div>
    <div class="big-discount"><sup>%</sup>25</div>
    <p class="discount-word">Discount</p>
    <p class="at-aarong">at <span>Aarong</span></p>
  </div>

  <div class="card-section">
    <p>Pay with your <strong>Prime Bank Employee Credit Card</strong><br/>and enjoy an instant 25% discount — no voucher needed.</p>
  </div>

  <div class="benefits">
    <table>
      <tr>
        <td>
          <div class="ben-icon">🏷️</div>
          <div class="ben-val">25%</div>
          <div class="ben-desc">Instant Discount<br/>at checkout</div>
        </td>
        <td>
          <div class="ben-icon">🛍️</div>
          <div class="ben-val">All Products</div>
          <div class="ben-desc">Valid on<br/><strong>all items</strong> at Aarong</div>
        </td>
        <td>
          <div class="ben-icon">💳</div>
          <div class="ben-val">Exclusive</div>
          <div class="ben-desc">Only for<br/><strong>Employee</strong> Cardholders</div>
        </td>
      </tr>
    </table>
  </div>

  <div class="cta">
    <p>Generate your exclusive coupon for online shopping at Aarong</p>
    <a href="{{.URL}}" class="cta-btn">Generate Coupon Now →</a>
    <p class="terms">*Valid exclusively for Prime Bank Employee Credit Cardholders.<br/>Applicable on all products at Aarong. Cannot be combined with other offers.</p>
  </div>

  <div class="footer">
    <p>© 2026 Prime Bank Limited. All rights reserved.</p>
    <p>You are receiving this as a Prime Bank Employee Credit Cardholder.</p>
    <p><a href="{{.URL}}">Unsubscribe</a> &nbsp;|&nbsp; <a href="{{.URL}}">Privacy Policy</a></p>
  </div>

</div>
</body>
</html>
